cpu.basis: The displayed model’s held-out whole-machine predictions; equal weight per configuration.
cpu.definition: e = ln(listed hourly price) - ln(held-out predicted hourly price)
cpu.validationMethod: Five deterministic folds of whole provider × machine families; no family appears in its training and test data.

gaussian.method: Normal maximum-likelihood fit: sample mean and population standard deviation (divisor n).

cpu.interpretation: A Gaussian overlay describes shape, not proof of model adequacy. Check bias, error size and patterns across price levels. Related configurations and reused training folds make residuals dependent; no independent-normality p-value or prediction interval is claimed.

gpu.basis: The displayed model’s held-out whole-machine predictions; equal weight per configuration.
gpu.definition: e = ln(listed hourly price) - ln(held-out predicted hourly price)
gpu.validationMethod: Leave one entire provider × machine family out. The CPU baseline excludes the same held-out host families.

gaussian.method: Normal maximum-likelihood fit: sample mean and population standard deviation (divisor n).

gpu.interpretation: A Gaussian overlay describes shape, not proof of model adequacy. Check bias, error size and patterns across price levels. Related configurations and reused training folds make residuals dependent; no independent-normality p-value or prediction interval is claimed.
